requirement.summary: Incorrect calculation for Municipality tax after waive by override condition
requirement.description:
It is available for Shiji Fiscal Exchange interface

Setup:

1. Setting for turn on municipality tax

*  Location: System Management > System Configuration > POS module

> Setup name: Support municipality tax

>> Value: Yes

2. Setting for tax setup with municipality tax

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Tax & S.C. Types

> Select target Tax (index: 1)

> Setting name: Rate (%)

>> Value: 24

> Setting name: Municipality Tax Index

>> Value: Select target tax index as Municipality Tax (index: 9)

> Setting name: Municipality Rate (%)

>> Value: Target tax rate for Municipality Tax (0.5%)

3. Setting for municipality tax setup

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Tax & S.C. Types

> Select target Tax as municipality tax  (index: 9)

> Setting name: Rate (%)

>> Value: 24 (same tax rate as Rate (%) on setup 2)

4. Setting for override condition for waive Municipality Tax

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Override Conditions

> Create / Edit target  Override Condition

> Under tab "General"

> Setting name: Custom Type

>> Value: Select target check type

> Select tab "Tax & S.C."

> Setting name: Tax 9

>> Value: Waive Tax for All Items

5. Setting for apply override conditions on old item when check type is changed

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Config by Location > Override Conditions Setting

> Select target Tax as municipality tax  (index: 9)

> Setting name: Apply override conditions on old items when check type is changed

>> Value: Yes

Workflow

1. Open new check

2. Order item with (Tax 1 and Municipality Tax 9 )

3. Click function "Assign Check Type" to select the target check to trigger override condition

4. System applys override condition to waive tax

* Municipality Tax 9 is waived

5. System wrongly calculates the check after waived Municipality Tax and posts the incorrect value to SFE

*  Tax 1 still calculated with the Municipality tax rate, and Municipality Tax is waived from check that the transaction total is matched on SFE packet

Expected result

System calculates the check after waived  Municipality Tax correctly and posts the expected value to SFE

*  Tax rate of tax 1 should rollback to 24% after Municipality Tax  (tax 9) is waived

*  Reference to attachment "Expected posting packet for SFE after waive Municipality tax (Provided by SFE)"

# POS0099 - Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment)

## Report Information

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment) |
| Code | POS0099 |

## Parameters to Validate

| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | Select the business date or date range of the report (single-select). Current Business Day: for a single outlet display the day that "Daily Start" performed, for multiple/all outlets display the largest business day of the selected outlets; Last Business Day: for a single outlet display the day that "Daily Close" performed, for multiple/all outlets display the largest business day of the selected outlets; Current Month: show current month data; Specified Date / Specified Date Range: show the specified day / period data | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Current Month, Specified Date, Specified Date Range | Current Business Day | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Shops | Filter report data by shop (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Outlets | Filter report data by outlet (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Department Level | Select the department level to display (single-select). Main Department: data from sub-departments are merged into the main department; Sub Department: show sub department information | Main Department, Sub Department | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Payment Method | Filter report data by payment method (multi-select). Note: show payment method name based on the config zone; if the target config zone does not set an override name, show the nearest parent config zone name | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Display Figure | Select the sales figure to display (single-select). Net: show net sales of item department; Gross: show gross sales of item department | Net, Gross | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Revenue/Non-Revenue | Filter data by revenue type (single-select). All: show information of both revenue and non-revenue payment methods; Payment (Revenue): show revenue payment information; Payment (Non-revenue): show non-revenue payment information | All, Payment (Revenue), Payment (Non-revenue) | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Display 25 Tax | Whether to display the 25 tax detail columns (single-select). Hide: do not show tax detail information; Display: show tax detail information | Hide, Display | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Attributes Condition | Condition to combine the selected attribute keys (single-select). And: show information satisfying all selected attribute keys; Or: show information satisfying any selected attribute key | And, Or | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Attribute Key | Filter report data by attribute key (multi-select); works together with Attributes Condition | All, Single, Multiple | All | - |
| Display Discount | Whether to display the discount section (single-select). Hide: hide discount section; Display: show discount section | Hide, Display | Display | - |
| Split Covers By Revenue Type | Whether to split guests by payment revenue type (single-select). Yes: guests are allocated by rounding off the payment ratio according to revenue type, the type with a larger proportion is given priority, the remaining guests are allocated to the other type; if ratios are the same, the revenue type that made the payment earlier is given priority; No: regardless of whether the first payment is revenue or non-revenue, guests of new checks are always added to the Revenue list | Yes, No | No | - |
| Display Discount By Department | Whether to display the discount by department section (single-select); enabled when Display Discount = 'Display'. Hide: do not display discount by department section; Show: display discount by department section | Hide, Show | Hide | - |

## Data Fields to Validate

### Report Header

| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shop Name | Show specified shop name; show "Shop Name" only when one shop is selected, not shown for multiple or all shops | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report name: Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment) | - | - |

| *All | Show "*All" in the report header | - | - |
| Business Day | Show specified date or date range | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock |
| Display Figure | Header indicator; show "Net" when parameter "Display Figure" = 'Net', show "Gross" when 'Gross' | - | - |

| Incl. Tax | Show inclusive tax amount | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |

| Department Name | Dynamic column(s) per item department; show department sales amount. Note: 1. if the item does not set an item department in the platform, department name shows "Undefined"; 2. show department net sales when "Display Figure" = 'Net'; 3. show department gross sales when "Display Figure" = 'Gross' | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: .; Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |

requirement.summary: General V3 membership interface - System refunds the last coupon only if voiding coupon item discount on multiple items
requirement.description:
It is available for General V3 membership interface

When voiding multiple coupon item discounts, system only triggers refund API to external party with the last coupon details, instead of triggering multiple APIs for each coupon found

Workflow

1. Follow existing workflow to apply General V3 coupon item discount to multiple items

2. Click function “Void Multiple Item Discount” to void all the discount coupons

3. System triggers external API "Prepare Refund Coupon" only once, with the requestCompletionId from the last coupon

Expected Result:

- If there are multiple coupons, system should refund those coupons instead of just refund the last coupon

- If error occurs during any one of the coupon refund, the remaining coupons will not be refunded. Item discount is voided for those successful refund coupons

requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 6.

Scope:

- Migration status file (in_progress / completed); migrate historical data 1 calendar month per scheduled run.

- Migrate rpt_dyn_pos_bir_business_days → pos_bir_station_summaries; rpt_dyn_pos_bir_check_payments → pos_bir_check_payments; build monthly summaries.

- During migration: dual-write old + new; after completed: new tables only.

- Report list: automatically route the 6 summary reports to new rptdesign after migration completes.

- Remove HQ fill-missing-month/day; HQ scheduled preprocess = migration (if needed) + cleanup only.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68290] Update BirPreprocessShell (Support data migration and old task cleanup)
Description:
-      Add historical migration from old dynamic BIR tables to new standard tables, plus cleanup of legacy scheduled jobs (Epic HERO-68279 Action 6).
-      JSON status file tracks in_progress / completed and last migrated date for resume; missing status file starts migration on the next run.
-      Migrate one calendar month per scheduled run: rpt_dyn_pos_bir_business_days → pos_bir_station_summaries; rpt_dyn_pos_bir_check_payments → pos_bir_check_payments; build pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for migrated months.
-      During in_progress: dual-write legacy and standard tables; when status is completed: standard tables only (ensure all historical months have monthly summaries before marking completed).
-      When migration completed, report list automatically routes six summary BIR reports to the new rptdesign (bir_ph, bir_sales_summary, bir_revenue_slip, bir_ph_by_running_number, bir_sfe_ph, bir_sfe_detail_ph).
-      After cutover, HQ scheduled preprocess no longer fills missing month/day; it runs migration (if still needed) and expired-data cleanup only. Local daily close generates day-to-day BIR data and syncs to HQ.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special UI configuration is required; migration is driven by BirPreprocessShell scheduled runs and the bir_migration.txt status file.
-      After cutover, BIR summary reports under Desktop Format use the new rptdesign automatically. Sample BIR report list:

# CUS0168 - Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department)

## Report Information
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department) |
| Code | CUS0168 |

## Parameters to Validate
| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | (single-select) Select the business date scope of the report. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified As Below | Current Business Day |
| Shops | (multi-select) Select shop(s) to filter report data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | (multi-select) Select outlet(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Categories | (multi-select) Select item category/categories to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Departments | (multi-select) Select item department(s) to filter report data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Employee | (multi-select) Select employee(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Meal Period | (multi-select) Select meal period(s) to filter report data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Report Format | (single-select) Select summary view (operation employee summary data) or detail view (operation employee details with item breakdown). | Summary, Detail | Summary |

## Data Fields to Validate
| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report title by selection [Date Type / Shops / Outlets]: shows report name 'Employee Itemized Sales Report (with Category & Department)'; shows shop name only if a single shop is selected; shows outlet name only if a single outlet is selected; shows target date for one day or target range date for a range. | - |
| Emp Number | Show user number. | - |
| Emp Name | Show user last and first name. | - |
| Code | Show item code. | - |
| Name | Show item name. | - |
| Discount | Show item discount, check discount and extra charge total within item. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Net Sales | Show item net sales: item sales amount after removing discount and extra charge. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | Net Sales = Item Sales Amount - Discount And Extra Charge |
| Qty | Show item quantity. | - |
| Total Sales | Show item sales amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . | - |
| Sub Total | Summarize Discount, Net Sales, Qty, Total Sales each column total by employee. | Sum of Discount / Net Sales / Qty / Total Sales per employee |
| Grand Total | Summarize Discount, Net Sales, Qty, Total Sales each column total for all employees. | Sum of Discount / Net Sales / Qty / Total Sales across all employees |
| ** END OF REPORT ** | Standard end-of-report marker. | - |
| Printed At | Show print date and time of the local server, format determined by the settings. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock | - |

| P. | Show page number. | - |

requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_sfe_detail_ph).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_sfe_detail_ph (MySQL + SQL Server).

- Detail layer reads pos_bir_check_payments or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (one row per payment/running number).

- Align with Action 4 on-demand routing for ranges beyond 3 months.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.summary: Action 5 / CUS313: BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_sfe_ph).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_sfe_ph (MySQL + SQL Server); same pattern as bir_ph (SFE variant).

- Read from new summary tables with 3-table UNION; resolve display fields from POS master data at runtime.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.summary: Action 5 / CUS012: BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_ph_by_running_number).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_ph_by_running_number (MySQL + SQL Server).

- Filter sum_type='r'; use pos_bir_daily_infos for start/end running numbers.

- 3-table UNION + long-range on-demand support.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_ph).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_ph (MySQL + SQL Server) to read new summary tables.

requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_revenue_slip).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_revenue_slip (MySQL + SQL Server) to read summary tables; filter sum_type='n'.

- Use 3-table UNION + JOIN pos_bir_daily_infos where needed.

- Support long-range / since-opening per Action 4 & Action 5 sections in the attached plan.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.summary: Action 5 / POS282: BIR Sales Summary Report
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 5 (bir_sales_summary).

Scope:

- Refactor bir_sales_summary (MySQL + SQL Server) to read new standard tables.

- Use 3-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary) + JOIN pos_bir_daily_infos for cumulative fields.

- Support year-to-date / since-opening via Action 4 on-demand routing.

- Station/payment display names resolved at report runtime from POS master data.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [HERO-68284,HERO-68285,HERO-68286,HERO-68287,HERO-68288,HERO-68289,HERO-69412] Update BIR reports to read new standard tables (summary and detail)
Description:
-      [POS282] BIR Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS063] Revenue Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS060] BIR Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS012] BIR Report (Philippines) (By Running Number) (MySQL only)
-      [CUS313] BIR-EIS Sales Summary Report (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [CUS314] BIR-EIS BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      [POS081] BIR Detail Report (Philippines) (MySQL & MSSQL)
-      Refactor the above BIR reports (Epic HERO-68279) so formal rptdesign files read the new standard pos_bir_* tables instead of legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* dynamic tables.
-      Summary reports use the shared three-table UNION (pos_bir_station_summaries + pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries + pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary), joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers / cumulative fields where needed; display names (station, payment) resolve from POS master data at runtime.
-      Detail reports read pos_bir_check_payments (within retention) or pos_bir_check_payments_temporary (on-demand), one row per payment / running number; they do not use monthly summaries and do not support since-opening (max range 3 months, enforced by Report Module on-demand routing).
-      Each report delivers a transitional _legacy.rptdesign (still reads rpt_dyn_*) alongside the formal design. Until migration completes, the Report Module routes to the legacy file; after migration completes, it uses the formal file. On-demand UI is enabled only when the transitional legacy design is present and the report is listed for on-demand.
-      Date-range routing and on-demand queueing are handled by the Report Module and report engine; preprocess / temporary table generation are handled by BirPreprocessShell.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No new report parameters are added. Existing date range and filter parameters are unchanged.
-      Open a covered BIR report from POS Module > Desktop Format. When the selected range is within retention, the viewer renders directly; when any date is older than retention, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No) soft-deletes the temporary preset and related one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent.
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition. Layout columns keep the existing dpbb_* / dpbp_* aliases; only the SQL data source changes.
Result / Sample:
-      Open a summary report (example: POS060 BIR Report (Philippines) / bir_ph) and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31).
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation.
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (email interface, recipients, format). After submit, the result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids.
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS060 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”); Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment.
-      After preprocess and AutoReport complete, the emailed report is produced from the formal design reading pos_bir_* ∪ temporary tables. Within retention, the same formal design renders directly without on-demand.
-      For a detail report (example: POS081 BIR Detail Report (Philippines) / bir_detail_ph), repeat with a range beyond retention but within 3 months: on-demand writes pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for the full range (no monthly segment reuse); ranges over 3 months are rejected.
-      Before migration completes, opening the same report uses the transitional *_legacy design against rpt_dyn_*; after migration status is completed, the formal design is used automatically.

requirement.summary: Action 4: Update Report Module & Engine (Support routing by date range)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 4.

Scope:

- Route by user date range: entirely within last 3 months → direct render from daily tables; any date older → full-range on-demand flow.

- On-demand: generate temp data into pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary / pos_bir_check_payments_temporary.

- Monthly speed-up: reuse pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for full months; recompute only incomplete first/last month segments.

- Shared report-engine / on-demand API changes only; per-report rptdesign refactor is covered by Action 5 tickets.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68283] Update Report Module & Engine (Support routing by date range)
Description:
-      Update shared Report Module and report engine to route BIR reports by the user-selected date range (Epic HERO-68279 Action 4). Per-report rptdesign changes remain in separate Action 5 tickets.
-      If the entire date range is within the last 3 months, render directly from daily tables (pos_bir_station_summaries / pos_bir_check_payments).
-      If any date is older than 3 months, use the full-range on-demand flow (do not split the range) and write temporary data to pos_bir_*_temporary tables.
-      For long ranges spanning multiple calendar months, reuse pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for complete months and recompute only incomplete first/last month segments.
-      On-demand job form collects shop (optional), date range, email interface and recipients; validates overlap; max range 12 months (365 days); “since opening” is summary-only.
-      Shared summary query uses UNION of daily, monthly, and temporary summary sources, joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers and cumulative fields.
-      Detail reports are limited to at most 3 months, do not use monthly summaries, and do not support “since opening”.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      Open a BIR on-demand-enabled report from POS Module > Desktop Format; when the selected range requires on-demand, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: set “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No). When Yes, soft-delete the temporary preset and one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent:
-
-      BIR report list (Desktop Format) used for routing entry:
-
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Open POS282 BIR Sales Summary Report and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31):
-
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation:
-
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (report, date range, email interface, recipients, format):
-
-      After submit, the job is queued. The result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids:
-
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the created on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS282 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”):
-
-      Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment (BIR on-demand …):

requirement.summary: Action 3: Update BirPreprocessShell (old/new write, daily/monthly, cleanup, On-Demand)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 3.

Scope:

- Update BirPreprocessShell for dual-write (old rpt_dyn_* + new pos_bir_*) during migration; new tables only after migration completes.

- Payment-level preprocess: write pos_bir_check_payments alongside existing dynamic payment table.

- Station daily summary: write pos_bir_station_summaries alongside existing dynamic business-day table.

- Monthly summary: aggregate from POS source data into pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries (invoked at Local daily close).

- Expired-data purge: 3-month daily retention, 10-year monthly/daily-info retention, temp table cleanup/DROP.

- On-Demand date-range generation into pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary / pos_bir_check_payments_temporary.

- Post-migration scheduled task: cleanup only (no HQ daily generation / backfill).
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68282] Update BirPreprocessShell (old/new write, daily/monthly, cleanup, On-Demand)
Description:
-      Update BirPreprocessShell for the new standard-table BIR preprocess architecture (Epic HERO-68279 Action 3), invoked from Local daily close via DailyPreprocessShell.
-      During migration, dual-write legacy rpt_dyn_pos_bir_* tables and new pos_bir_* tables; after migration completes, write new standard tables only.
-      Payment-level preprocess writes pos_bir_check_payments; station daily summary writes pos_bir_station_summaries; monthly summary aggregates into pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries at Local daily close.
-      Retention: purge daily rows in pos_bir_station_summaries / pos_bir_check_payments older than 3 months; apply 10-year policy on long-term tables; drop temporary tables when empty.
-      Support On-Demand date-range mode to populate pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary and pos_bir_check_payments_temporary for report on-demand flow (Action 4).
-      After migration, HQ/LS scheduled preprocess performs cleanup only (no HQ daily generation or backfill of missing days/months).
Configuration / Parameter:
-      No special UI configuration is required for daily/monthly preprocess; it runs from Local daily close / scheduled tasks.
-      Optional Report Module setting “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” controls soft-delete of temporary preset and one-time tasks after on-demand send:
-
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.

requirement.summary: HKJC - TMS - Solace tool for export file support .cnt and .pos files
requirement.description:
Use Case / Background:

HKJC have three export files need to transfer via Solace. Solace tool for exported file transfer was developed. Previous the tool supports transfer of .zip files. It's required now to support the file type to .cnt and .pos files as well.

Requirement:

System detects and sends all the relevant .cnt / .pos / .zip files in the directory set in File Path and match File name pattern. ** Only limit to these 3 types, no need to send other file types.
